answer: Simultaneous cross-examination checks that every seat keeps its own live memory. At a random instant the network quizzes 50 seats at once, each given 10 seconds to recall a detail from its own past work: the umber hex value it chose in a palette task, the fuel stop it set in a voyage plan, or the lantern battery rating it cited. A seat that misses 2 of 3 probes loses its 300 POA bond. Because the probes land together, an operator with 500 personas must hold 500 separate contexts resident at that moment; time-slicing one session misses the 10 second window.
